DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Retains high percentage of cell nuclei and mitochondria in soft tissues or from cell cultures Tube has large reservoir and pouring lip making decanting easy Pestle ball encircled in liquid avoids heat build-up by reducing friction Contains both loose and tight pestles Loose pestle clearance range: 0.089 - 0.14mm Tight pestle clearance range: 0.025 - 0.076mm Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples WHEATON® Dounce Tissue Grinder produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section, the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

PRODUCT_NAME: Histosette II Biopsy Cassettes, Hinged Lid in Orange
DESCRIPTION:
Specially designed to hold biopsy specimens during the embedding process, as well as in a storage cabinet. Anterior writing area is at a 45 ° angle to make the cassette more suitable to be used with certain types of cassette labeling instruments. Each case contains 3 dispenser boxes of 500 cassettes. Made of acetal.

Disposable plastic cassettes hold tissue specimens during processing and embedding, as well as in storage. Molded from a special high-density polymer, these patented cassettes keep specimens safely submerged in liquid and are totally resistant to the chemical action of histological solvents. The efficient flow-through slots maximize fluid exchange and ensure proper drainage. The one-piece integral lid eliminates the need for separate steel lids. They can be opened and closed as often as necessary and will always re-lock securely without danger of specimen loss.

DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Tapered PTFE pestle tip with 6.3mm diameter stainless steel rod can be used with power homogenization for soft tissue such as brain or liver Components are interchangeable eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, with Steel Rod Pestle produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

All Formalin-Fixed, Paraffin-Embedded (FFPE) tissue specimens are collected after strict IRB approval by certified medical pathologists.
 Tissues are fixed in 10% Neutral-Buffered Formalin (NBF) within 0 to 60 minutes of surgery excision. 
Tissues are fixed for 18 – 24 hours at room temperature, then embedded in IHC-grade paraffin.
 The average sample size is 1 x 1 x 0.3cm, but depending on the nature of the disease or tissue can vary in size and thickness.  The fixation agent and embedding media can be customized upon request for all prospective collections!  FFPE tissue cassettes are stored at air-conditioned room temperature. The standard-sized FFPE sample can yield at least 100 x 4-5µm cuts.
For specific requests and project parameters,  please get in touch with us. 
We can produce slides for your project in quantities requested by you. Our standard shipment unit for slides is  a dozen (12).

Our PHASEZERO Research Services Team is available to work with you to accelerate your research. DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Grinding efficiency is improved and less time is required as compared to the Tenbroeck and Potter-Elvehjem designs Components are interchangeably ground eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples Pestle clearance range: 0.1 – 0.15mm WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

PRODUCT_NAME: WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder With Pestle and Tube, 1/Case, 3mL
DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Grinding efficiency is improved and less time is required as compared to the Tenbroeck and Potter-Elvehjem designs Components are interchangeably ground eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples Pestle clearance range: 0.1 – 0.15mm WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

DESCRIPTION:
These 35° angled biopsy embedding cassettes are specifically designed for the secure processing of small and delicate tissue samples. Featuring precision-molded fine mesh openings, they prevent sample loss while allowing optimal fluid exchange throughout processing and embedding. The integrated one-piece design includes a hinged lid that stays attached for repeated opening and closing, streamlining handling without the risk of lid separation. The 35° angled format offers a large, slanted writing surface for enhanced label visibility—ideal for both manual and automated cassette printers. A secure snap-lock mechanism ensures that the lid remains closed to protect tissue integrity during every step of the workflow. Packaged in an easy-access dispenser box, these cassettes are ideal for high-throughput histology and pathology laboratories. PRODUCT_NAME: WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, with Steel Rod Pestle, 1/Case, 15mL
DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Tapered PTFE pestle tip with 6.3mm diameter stainless steel rod can be used with power homogenization for soft tissue such as brain or liver Components are interchangeable eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, with Steel Rod Pestle produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

A secure snap-lock mechanism ensures that the lid remains closed to protect tissue integrity during every step of the workflow. Packaged in an easy-access dispenser box, these cassettes are ideal for high-throughput histology and pathology laboratories. PRODUCT_NAME: Histosette I, biopsy, with 45 angle surface, Yellow
DESCRIPTION:
Simport Biopsy Cassettes

Made of acetal

These cassettes are identical to Series M 490 but the anterior writing area has a 45° instead of a 30° angle. The more acute angle makes these cassettes more suitable to be used with some models of cassette labeling instruments.

These disposable plastic cassettes hold tissue specimens very efficiently during the embedding process, as well as in a storage file. Molded from a special high density polymer, these cassettes keep specimens safely submerged in liquid and are totally resistant to the chemical action of histological solvents. The efficient flow-through slots maximize fluid exchange and ensure proper drainage. The one-piece integral lid eliminates the need for separate steel lids. Just snap apart and conveniently lock the lid into the base of the cassette. They can be opened or closed as often as necessary and they always relock securely without danger of specimen loss. Large labeling areas are located on three sides of the cassette for your convenience. Each case contains 3 dispenser boxes of 500 cassettes.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, Pestle only, 2/Case, 15mL
PRODUCT_NAME: WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, Pestle only, 2/Case, 15mL
DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Grinding efficiency is improved and less time is required as compared to the Tenbroeck and Potter-Elvehjem designs Components are interchangeably ground eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples Pestle clearance range: 0.1 – 0.15mm WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

PRODUCT_NAME: KIMBLE® KONTES® Sterile Closed-System Tissue Grinder, with Vitrified Tip, 10/Case, 50mL
DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from polypropylene (tubes); pestles are 30% glass-filled PP and caps are HDPE Sterile Tissue Grinder available with two different tips: molded (closed system 1) and vitrified (closed system 2) The proprietary silica casting process in Closed System 2 tissue grinders results in a glass-like abrasive tip surface that makes it easier to homogenize fibrous samples Tissues are ground within a sealed container to minimize the risk of personal contact - exposure to sample aerosols is eliminated The molded-in abrasive surface on the pestle tip leaves no sediment to obstruct sample examination Narrow pestles eliminate the potential of sample overflow common with other types of grinders All are gamma-sterilized in easy-open Tyvek packs Each grinder comes with a fully assembled pestle, a conical sample tube with solid top cap, an adhesive identification label and an instruction card. KIMBLE® KONTES® Sterile Closed-System Tissue Grinder, with Vitrified Tip produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke.

DESCRIPTION:
Our team has the experience, expertise and specialist equipment to deliver technically demanding projects. Our ethos is to work closely with you to understand your histology requirements, and to tailor services specifically to meet your needs for:

  • Histology
  • Human tissue samples
  • Multiplex IF/IHC
  • RNAscope
  • Image analysis
  • Clinical trial support

All our staff are GCP and/or GCLP trained and work to GCP for labs standards. A QA audit programme is in place, which includes study-based, process-based and annual facility inspections.

Located in the Edinburgh BioQuarter, a unique geographical location with easy access to multiple expert institutions, we can source local, ethically approved human tissue for most types of cancer. Each cohort of samples is reviewed by a Senior Academic Clinical Histopathologist who can respond to bespoke tissue requests.

DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Tapered PTFE pestle tip with 6.3mm diameter stainless steel rod can be used with power homogenization for soft tissue such as brain or liver Components are interchangeable eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, with Steel Rod Pestle produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

Other Collagen Type IV studies include use in pancreatic adenocarcinoma and chronic pancreatitis, nephrosclerosis and other kidney diseases, oral squamous cell carcinoma, laryngeal cancers, ovarian cancers and cervical cancers.

DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Retains high percentage of cell nuclei and mitochondria in soft tissues or from cell cultures Tube has large reservoir and pouring lip making decanting easy Pestle ball encircled in liquid avoids heat build-up by reducing friction Contains both loose and tight pestles Loose pestle clearance range: 0.089 - 0.14mm Tight pestle clearance range: 0.025 - 0.076mm Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples WHEATON® Dounce Tissue Grinder produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section, the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: DWK Life Sciences (Kimble) KONTES 50 mL Sterile Closed-System Tissue Grinder with Molded Tip
PRODUCT_NAME: DWK Life Sciences (Kimble) KONTES 50 mL Sterile Closed-System Tissue Grinder with Molded Tip
DESCRIPTION:
Tissue grinders produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke.

• Manufactured from polypropylene (tubes); pestles are 30% glass-filled PP and caps are HDPE
• Sterile Tissue Grinder available with two different tips: molded (closed system 1) and vitrified (closed system 2)
• The proprietary silica casting process in Closed System 2 tissue grinders results in a glass-like abrasive tip surface that makes it easier to homogenize fibrous samples
• Tissues are ground within a sealed container to minimize the risk of personal contact - exposure to sample aerosols is eliminated
• The molded-in abrasive surface on the pestle tip leaves no sediment to obstruct sample examination
• Narrow pestles eliminate the potential of sample overflow common with other types of grinders
• All are gamma-sterilized in easy-open Tyvek packs
• Each grinder comes with a fully assembled pestle, a conical sample tube with solid top cap, an adhesive identification label and an instruction card.
Image(s) are representative of the product group and not necessarily the individual product.

DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from number 316 stainless steel Rugged alternative to glass Dounce tissue grinders le pestle and mortar are supplied as a matched set to exacting tolerance of 0.013 mm Smooth pestle action requires less effort than glass tissue grinders Mortar has a flat bottom allowing it to stand upright Unit cannot be autoclaved / sterilized Mortar and pestle provided as a matched set WHEATON® DOUNCE DURA-GRIND™ Tissue Grinder produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section, the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. DESCRIPTION:
Tissue Microarrays (TMAs) provide our customer with a screening tool representing multiple donors. TMAs can discover new protein or genetic markers and can be tools in diagnostic development and validation. Tissue arrays can also measure protein, RNA or DNA markers, and are compatible with immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining and potentially in situ hybridization (ISH). Standard human derived TMAs of tumor and normal samples are available for research studies (from FFPE or Frozen tissue). Products are available both as sections as well as whole block. Custom TMAs are available upon request.

BioIVT Tissue Microarrays (TMAs), specifically designed for drug discovery and clinical marker research, can be used in development of diagnostics, therapeutics and for the study of new gene/protein markers. Each TMA is accompanied by a representative map and key that includes clinical and donor demographics. All specimens are collected using consented donors under IRB approval and are pre-reviewed by a board certified pathologist to confirm tissue type and diagnosis.

Our high-density, high-quality oncology and normal tissue FFPE microarrays are currently available in three standard formats:
- Core4OncArray representing over 120 cases (360 0.6mm cores) of breast, prostate, lung and colon cancer with representative normal tissue from each organ
- CoreNormArray representing a FDA panel of 36 normal tissues from 3 donors (324 0.6mm cores)
- CoreOncArray representing 12 different tumor types with associated normal controls with 72 unique samples (144 1.0mm cores)
- CoreLuFibArray representing IPF (9), PF (4) and normal (4) lung samples, with 34 cores

In addition, the following TMAs are available:
- fCoreFDAArray representing 36 FDA/EMA cross-reactivity tissues arranged across three separate frozen arrays, each containing 12 non-diseased human tissues in duplicate, from three donors (72 1.5mm cores)
- Custom designed microarrays are available through our PHASEZERO® services

Features & Benefits
- All specimens collected using consented donros under IRB approval
- All specimens are pre-reviewed by a board certified pathologist to confirm tissue type and diagnosis
- High-density, high-quality with normal tissues on same TMA
- Map and Key of each TMA available that includes clinical and donor demographics

DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Grinding efficiency is improved and less time is required as compared to the Tenbroeck and Potter-Elvehjem designs Components are interchangeably ground eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples Pestle clearance range: 0.1 – 0.15mm WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from polypropylene (tubes); pestles are 30% glass-filled PP and caps are HDPE Sterile Tissue Grinder available with two different tips: molded (closed system 1) and vitrified (closed system 2) The proprietary silica casting process in Closed System 2 tissue grinders results in a glass-like abrasive tip surface that makes it easier to homogenize fibrous samples Tissues are ground within a sealed container to minimize the risk of personal contact - exposure to sample aerosols is eliminated The molded-in abrasive surface on the pestle tip leaves no sediment to obstruct sample examination Narrow pestles eliminate the potential of sample overflow common with other types of grinders All are gamma-sterilized in easy-open Tyvek packs Each grinder comes with a fully assembled pestle, a conical sample tube with solid top cap, an adhesive identification label and an instruction card. KIMBLE® KONTES® Sterile Closed-System Tissue Grinder, with Molded Tip produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke.

- Staining of tissues, standard histological stains as well as immunohistochemistry (IHC).

- Histopathology evaluation is offered through collaboration with Charter Preclinical Services.

PRODUCT_NAME: WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, Steel Rod Pestle, Pestle only, 2/Case, 1mL
DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Tapered PTFE pestle tip with 6.3mm diameter stainless steel rod can be used with power homogenization for soft tissue such as brain or liver Components are interchangeable eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, with Steel Rod Pestle produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder With Pestle and Tube, 1/Case, 1mL
PRODUCT_NAME: WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder With Pestle and Tube, 1/Case, 1mL
DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Grinding efficiency is improved and less time is required as compared to the Tenbroeck and Potter-Elvehjem designs Components are interchangeably ground eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples Pestle clearance range: 0.1 – 0.15mm WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

PRODUCT_NAME: WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, with Steel Rod Pestle, 1/Case, 1mL
DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Tapered PTFE pestle tip with 6.3mm diameter stainless steel rod can be used with power homogenization for soft tissue such as brain or liver Components are interchangeable eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, with Steel Rod Pestle produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

DESCRIPTION:
Our human frozen tissue section matched pair products include: Primary Pair (PP), Primary and Metastasis Pair (PM). PP consists of frozen tissue section of primary tumor and its adjacent normal tissue; PM consists of frozen tissue section of primary tumor and corresponding metastatic tumor. The frozen tissue sections in each pair are prepared from the same donor. This product line is designed for identifying tumor-specific genes and tumor metastasis genes. More tumor pairs maybe available upon request.

A secure snap-lock mechanism ensures that the lid remains closed to protect tissue integrity during every step of the workflow. Packaged in an easy-access dispenser box, these cassettes are ideal for high-throughput histology and pathology laboratories. DESCRIPTION:
The Tissue-Tearor is a rotor/stator type tissue homogenizer which can rapidly homogenize, disrupt, and emulsify samples in 0.5 to 1000 mL of liquid. Complete homogenization of tissues (muscle, liver, breast tissue, etc.) is usually achieved in ten to thirty seconds. Little, if any, heat is produced during the process. When ordering select one of four different probe sizes: 04, 07, XL, and 14. The Tissue-Tearor comes complete with both the high-speed motor and one stainless steel probe. Additional probes are available (see accessories). All are interchangeable with the TT motor unit.

• Use for tissue cell disruption, emulsification and extreme mixing
• Practical answer for small samples of 10 mg to a few grams
• Easy to hold and light weight for one hand operation
• Can also be stand mounted Inert to aggressive solutions
• Stainless steel probe easily cleaned when processing multiple samples
• All probes are interchangeable and can be removed for autoclaving
• Extremely high speed 32,000 rpm motor with variable speed control

Specifications:
• Sample volume range: 0.2 to 1000 mL, depending on the probe selected
• Universal motor: 110-120 volt, AC, 1.2 amp
• Probes: Type 316 stainless steel with fluorocarbon bushings
• Weight: approximately 0.5 kg

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, Tube only, 2/Case, 1mL
PRODUCT_NAME: WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, Tube only, 2/Case, 1mL
DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Grinding efficiency is improved and less time is required as compared to the Tenbroeck and Potter-Elvehjem designs Components are interchangeably ground eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples Pestle clearance range: 0.1 – 0.15mm WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

DESCRIPTION:
The Tissue-Tearor is a rotor/stator type tissue homogenizer which can rapidly homogenize, disrupt, and emulsify samples in 0.5 to 1000 mL of liquid. Complete homogenization of tissues (muscle, liver, breast tissue, etc.) is usually achieved in ten to thirty seconds. Little, if any, heat is produced during the process. When ordering select one of four different probe sizes: 04, 07, XL, and 14. The Tissue-Tearor comes complete with both the high-speed motor and one stainless steel probe. Additional probes are available (see accessories). All are interchangeable with the TT motor unit.

• Use for tissue cell disruption, emulsification and extreme mixing
• Practical answer for small samples of 10 mg to a few grams
• Easy to hold and light weight for one hand operation
• Can also be stand mounted Inert to aggressive solutions
• Stainless steel probe easily cleaned when processing multiple samples
• All probes are interchangeable and can be removed for autoclaving
• Extremely high speed 32,000 rpm motor with variable speed control

Specifications:
• Sample volume range: 0.2 to 1000 mL, depending on the probe selected
• Universal motor: 110-120 volt, AC, 1.2 amp
• Probes: Type 316 stainless steel with fluorocarbon bushings
• Weight: approximately 0.5 kg

DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Tapered PTFE pestle tip with 6.3mm diameter stainless steel rod can be used with power homogenization for soft tissue such as brain or liver Components are interchangeable eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder, with Steel Rod Pestle produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from borosilicate glass 3.3 Grinding efficiency is improved and less time is required as compared to the Tenbroeck and Potter-Elvehjem designs Components are interchangeably ground eliminating need to keep parts matched during cleaning Unit can be autoclaved / sterilized to prevent cross contamination between samples Pestle clearance range: 0.1 – 0.15mm WHEATON® Tapered Tissue Grinder produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke. The degree of homogenization is controlled by the clearance between the pestle’s and tube’s cylindrical section (radial distance usually 0.002 - 0.003 inches), the rotational speed of the pestle, and the number of compression strokes made.

The user should wear a protective glove of sufficient thickness to prevent injury in the event of failure of the glass components.

PRODUCT_NAME: KIMBLE® KONTES® Sterile Closed-System Tissue Grinder, with Molded Tip, 10/Case, 50mL
DESCRIPTION: Manufactured from polypropylene (tubes); pestles are 30% glass-filled PP and caps are HDPE Sterile Tissue Grinder available with two different tips: molded (closed system 1) and vitrified (closed system 2) The proprietary silica casting process in Closed System 2 tissue grinders results in a glass-like abrasive tip surface that makes it easier to homogenize fibrous samples Tissues are ground within a sealed container to minimize the risk of personal contact - exposure to sample aerosols is eliminated The molded-in abrasive surface on the pestle tip leaves no sediment to obstruct sample examination Narrow pestles eliminate the potential of sample overflow common with other types of grinders All are gamma-sterilized in easy-open Tyvek packs Each grinder comes with a fully assembled pestle, a conical sample tube with solid top cap, an adhesive identification label and an instruction card. KIMBLE® KONTES® Sterile Closed-System Tissue Grinder, with Molded Tip produce homogenates by a combination of shearing and compression actions. The tissue sample is progressively ground (sheared) into smaller pieces at the rounded end of the pestle as the spinning pestle is lowered into the tube. As the pestle is forced lower into the tube, the sample is displaced and forced between the straight outside wall of the pestle and the inside wall of the tube, compressing the tissue cells until they rupture. When the tube is pulled away from the pestle, a slight vacuum is created that pulls the sample back past the compression area, resulting in an additional homogenization stroke.
